verdict.rationale: The evidence covers document-to-markdown/JSON conversion and structured field extraction with bounding-box citations (datalab-docs-17, datalab-docs-18), but nothing in the pack specifically addresses figure/chart detection, VLM-generated image descriptions, or image crops tied back to page position — the core ask of this story. Missing for 10: evidence of figure/image extraction as distinct elements, VLM-based captioning/summarization of charts, and explicit bounding-box/page linkage for those visual elements.
